name: Act I: Static
description: The fractured network awakens. Learn the basics of message routing.

messages.content_snippet: Simple trade agreement between Harbor and Market.
Medical supply requisition for the eastern settlements.
Letter from a farmer to family at the harbor.
Scouting report from the western outpost. Archive requested this data.
Militia patrol schedule. Standard update to Market contacts.

dialogue.speaker: System
dialogue.text: The network flickers to life. Static fills the airwaves, but beneath it... signals. Messages waiting to be heard.

dialogue.speaker: System
dialogue.text: You are the last operator. The fractured communities depend on you to route their messages through the noise.

dialogue.speaker: System
dialogue.text: Choose wisely. Every message carries weight. Every path has risks.

dialogue.speaker: System
dialogue.text: Message delivered. The recipient's gratitude echoes through the network.

dialogue.speaker: System
dialogue.text: But be careful - not all eyes in this network are friendly. Some watch. Some listen. Some intercept.

dialogue.speaker: System
dialogue.text: The static is clearing. Your reputation grows. The communities are beginning to trust the network again.

dialogue.speaker: System
dialogue.text: But with clarity comes attention. New signals emerge... and new threats.
